plan.title: Emoji and non-Latin title round trip

steps.note: Open a valid multi-stage project creation screen.
Set the exact Unicode title under test.
Apply a pricing template so line items can be added.
Add the required line item for a valid event.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite a vendor so the vendor-side rendering can be checked.
Publish the event whose title will be round-tripped.
Confirm publication succeeded before reopening it.
Return to the events list to verify the title in the list row.
Confirm the list rendered without an error.
Assert the exact Unicode title is searchable and rendered in the list.
Reopen the plan's published event from the list.
Assert the detail page displays the event title value without mojibake.
Move to the invited vendor's view to verify the invitation rendering.
Open this event's vendor overview rather than entering the bid form.
Assert the exact Unicode title is visible to the vendor.
